newsitem.title: USA: Edison electric car unit expands marketing.
newsitem.headline: Edison electric car unit expands marketing.

text.p: Edison International's Edison EV said Wednesday it has formed alliances with three major electric utilities in California to help set up electric vehicle charging equipment.

In addition to Edison's own Southern California Edison Co, an agreement has been signed with Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric Co and negotiations with Sacramento Municipal Utility District are ongoing, the Edison division said in a release.

"Building a charging infrastructure to meet the needs of electric vehicle owners and public charging customers simply can't be done by any single company ...," said Edison EV president Diane Wittenberg.
"To succeed, Edison EV needs strong alliances with local electric utilities, and equally strong partnerships with the makers of electric vehicles and chargers," she said.
Edison said the agreements address sales and marketing of electric vehicle chargers in each utility's service territory.

Edison EV is also allied with General Motors to provide residential chargers for owners of GM's new EV1 electric vehicle, which has just been launched in California and Arizona and is being marketed through Saturn showrooms.
